title: momino haidere qarrar ka matam karlo
body:
momino haidere qarrar ka matam karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye Ali ya Ali x 8
<<MINI>>
Momino haidere qarrar ka maatam karlo x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo mohammad ke alamdaar ka maatam karlo
<<MINI>>
Momino haidere qarrar ka maatam karlo x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jo ke paacho me bhi hai 12 imamo me bhi hai x 2
Saare nabiyo ke madadgar ka matam karlo
2. Khaak udaao ke Ali shere khuda maare gaye x 2
Bazue Ahmede mukhtar ka maatam karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Milke jibreel ke ustaad ka pursa dedo x 2
Saahibe duldulo talwaar ka matam karlo
4. Apne qaatil ko diya jisne ke jaame shireen x 2
Kausari jaam ke mukhtar ka matam karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ay nusayri muje pursa de mere maula ka x 2
Apne rab mere madadgar ka matam karlo
6. Wo jo zehra ke janaze pe raha mehwe fuga x 2
Aye azadaro azadar ka matam karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Marte dam jisko tha zaynab ki aseeri ka khayal x 2
Ayse mazloom hayadar ka matam karlo
8. Khil uthi thi jo kabhi waqte nuzoole haydar
Aaj usi kaabe ki deewar ka maatam karlo
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Sogwaarane ali meesumo rehan ho tum
Dam ba dam sayyade abraar ka matam karlo.
